thread.title: Apple’s (AAPL) “Buy” Rating Reiterated at UBS Group

author: John Adams
title: Apple’s (AAPL) “Buy” Rating Reiterated at UBS Group
text:
Posted by John Adams on Jan 15th, 2019 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) ‘s stock had its “buy” rating reiterated by equities researchers at UBS Group in a research note issued to investors on Monday, www.analystratings.com reports. They currently have a $180.00 target price on the iPhone maker’s stock. UBS Group’s target price points to a potential upside of 20.00% from the company’s previous close.
AAPL has been the topic of several other reports. Morgan Stanley reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $247.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 10th. BidaskClub lowered shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Wednesday, November 28th. HSBC lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 target price on the stock. in a research report on Sunday, December 9th. Finally, Needham & Company LLC decreased their target price on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $180.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research report on Thursday, January 3rd. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.19. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of AAPL opened at $150.00 on Monday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. The firm has a market capitalization of $748.53 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.59, a PEG ratio of 1.44 and a beta of 1.23. Apple has a 1 year low of $142.00 and a 1 year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. Apple’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $2.07 EPS. As a group, equities research analysts expect that Apple will post 12.1 EPS for the current year.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.05% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
A number of large investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Boussard & Gavaudan Investment Management LLP acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at about $11,111,000. DNB Asset Management AS increased its stake in shares of Apple by 19.3% during the 4th quarter. DNB Asset Management AS now owns 1,518,495 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $239,527,000 after acquiring an additional 245,877 shares during the last quarter. Rosenbaum Jay D. increased its stake in shares of Apple by 1.1% during the 4th quarter. Rosenbaum Jay D. now owns 9,468 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,494,000 after acquiring an additional 105 shares during the last quarter. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors increased its stake in shares of Apple by 15.1% during the 4th quarter. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors now owns 54,537 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,602,000 after acquiring an additional 7,149 shares during the last quarter. Finally, QCI Asset Management Inc. NY increased its stake in shares of Apple by 42.2% during the 4th quarter. QCI Asset Management Inc. NY now owns 172,638 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,232,000 after acquiring an additional 51,192 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors own 57.04% of the company’s stock.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
